continuous_master_alignment.method: Decode full final AAC and matching 0–103-second master excerpt to aligned 48kHz mono float PCM, without offset search.
continuous_master_alignment.interpretation: Confirms continuous aligned master excerpt after lossy AAC encoding; not a human listening or naturalness judgment.

visual_review.method: Assistant inspection of per-shot filmstrips, paired delivery frames at every cut, six representative captioned delivery frames and the hummingbird detail crop. Not a full human moving-picture or listening review.
observations: Four main animal identities remain recognizable in the reviewed frames; the layout carries across cuts with small pose and texture shifts.
Caption text stays in the lower reserved area and is readable in the inspected frames.
Parrots, hummingbird and bee are small and clear of hero faces; the hummingbird is especially subtle against foliage.
The bee uses one event clock across the 81-second cut, preserving its path, wing phase and fade.
Exact dialogue gaze timing and lip synchronization are not established. The unicorn horn darkens in continuation footage.
Painted road markings appear in job 3, then recede in job 4. Stylized gates, vegetation and cliffs are not verified geographic reconstruction.
visual_review.decision: Retain the longest funded sequence with recorded limitations; no paid rerolls.

viewer.method: HTML link existence and Node syntax; no browser playback claim.
